cohort: Patients admitted to the obstetrical emergency ward of a rural tertiary care center in North India during a 6-month period before and a 6-month period during the COVID-19 pandemic.
finding: There was a significant reduction in obstetrical emergency admissions during the COVID-19 pandemic compared to before the pandemic, alongside a significant increase in cesarean deliveries, maternal mortality, intrauterine deaths, and stillbirths.
